functions-for-submitting-a-bundle.text: Names, argument names and result types only. No bodies.

provider-module.text: inclusion(network, transactionIds): for each identity, found with chain point and confirmations, or not found; a named read failure otherwise.

signing-module.text: assembleSigned(tx, witnesses): the signed transaction with the body bytes and identity of tx and exactly witnesses.

submit-planner-module.text: neededKeys(bundle, resolvedInputs): for each transaction, the key hashes needing a witness. Pure.

submit-module.text: submitBundle(bundlePath, witnessPaths, receiptPath): reads, resolves, plans, sends in order, reads the chain again, writes the receipt; refuses with a named refusal.

command-module.text: submitCommand(bundlePath, witnessPaths, nodeSettings, receiptPath): the parsed submit command; it accepts the node settings and refuses every wallet and vault option by name.
